limitations.note: The rewrite removed the combinational counter defect but replaced the three-input sequence with disjoint pairs, dropping the output that combines the previous byte’s low nibble with the full third byte.
The test explicitly expected no output on the third valid input, so its passing result confirmed the rewrite’s assumption instead of catching the missing valid output carrying 0xD12.
